first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence suggests shortening onboarding and reducing signup friction improve early adoption. A small guarded test is the best fit for the immediate funnel problem while monitoring qualified conversion and downstream revenue to avoid trading quality for volume.

final.rationale: Run a guarded onboarding simplification test focused on SMB self-serve accounts, where the evidence applies. Shortened onboarding improved completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention; signup simplification also improved activation and qualified revenue, though its small retention decline warrants monitoring. Measure completion, activation, time-to-value, 30-day retention, qualified conversion, and qualified revenue before broader rollout. This directly addresses both current funnel declines while avoiding an unvalidated broad response to competitor pricing.
